theorems.name: HostLocality.encodeDecision_wellFormed
theorems.claim: Both modeled bounded-read outcomes encode with a recognized result tag and an exact payload length.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.encodeDecision_wellFormed : ∀ (decision : HostLocality.ReadDecision), HostLocality.responseWellFormed (HostLocality.encodeDecision decision)

theorems.name: HostLocality.readDecision_success
theorems.claim: An exact-representation, exact-handle, in-bounds request with authorized access returns precisely the selected byte slice.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.readDecision_success : ∀ (region : HostLocality.Region) (request : HostLocality.ReadRequest), request.representation = 1 → request.claim = region.identity → HostLocality.withinBounds region request → ∀ (accessAllowed : Bool), accessAllowed = true → HostLocality.readDecision region request accessAllowed = HostLocality.ReadDecision.success (List.take request.length (List.drop request.offset region.bytes))

theorems.name: HostLocality.readDecision_domainError
theorems.claim: An exact-representation, exact-handle, in-bounds request denied by native access yields the modeled invalid-handle domain error.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.readDecision_domainError : ∀ (region : HostLocality.Region) (request : HostLocality.ReadRequest), request.representation = 1 → request.claim = region.identity → HostLocality.withinBounds region request → ∀ (accessAllowed : Bool), accessAllowed = false → HostLocality.readDecision region request accessAllowed = HostLocality.ReadDecision.domainError HostLocality.invalidHandleBytes

theorems.name: HostLocality.t5_decision_logic_relation
theorems.claim: Under the explicit wrapper-response refinement premise, result validation precedes restoration of only the declared borrowed handle, preserves its original prefix position, and pushes the exact response.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.t5_decision_logic_relation : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState) (decision : HostLocality.ReadDecision) (response : HostLocality.WireResponse), HostLocality.WrapperResponseRefines decision response → response = HostLocality.encodeDecision decision ∧ HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned response)) = HostLocality.restoredGuest borrow response ∧ (HostLocality.restoredGuest borrow response).stack = borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner borrow.owner, HostLocality.StackCell.response response] ∧ borrow.position = borrow.prefix.length

theorems.name: HostLocality.guest_call_collection_exact
theorems.claim: The modeled call stack contains the owner, offset, and length after its unchanged prefix; argument collection saves the owner and leaves exactly that prefix.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.guest_call_collection_exact : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState) (request : HostLocality.ReadRequest), HostLocality.guestCallStack borrow request = borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner borrow.owner, HostLocality.StackCell.natural request.offset, HostLocality.StackCell.natural request.length] ∧ (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow).stack = borrow.prefix ∧ (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow).borrowed = some borrow ∧ borrow.position = borrow.prefix.length

theorems.name: HostLocality.restoration_before_validation_is_noop
theorems.claim: Before result validation, restoration is a no-op and its stack differs from a mutant that prematurely appends the borrowed owner.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.restoration_before_validation_is_noop : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) = HostLocality.collectGuest borrow ∧ (HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow)).stack = borrow.prefix ∧ (HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow)).phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.suspended ∧ (HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow)).stack ≠ borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner borrow.owner]

theorems.name: HostLocality.malformed_return_has_no_guest_continuation
theorems.claim: An ABI-malformed returned response aborts the modeled guest call without continuing or restoring the owner to its guest stack.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.malformed_return_has_no_guest_continuation : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState) (response : HostLocality.WireResponse), ¬HostLocality.responseWellFormed response → have after := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned response)); after.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ after.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ after.borrowed = some borrow ∧ after.response = none

theorems.name: HostLocality.trapped_call_has_no_guest_continuation
theorems.claim: A trapped modeled call aborts without guest continuation or owner restoration.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.trapped_call_has_no_guest_continuation : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), have after := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) HostLocality.HostExit.trapped); after.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ after.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ after.borrowed = some borrow ∧ after.response = none

theorems.name: HostLocality.malformed_tag_rejected
theorems.claim: The unsupported result-tag fixture fails the modeled ABI response validation.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.malformed_tag_rejected : ¬HostLocality.responseWellFormed HostLocality.malformedTagFixture

theorems.name: HostLocality.altered_result_length_rejected
theorems.claim: The inconsistent result-length fixture fails the modeled ABI response validation.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.altered_result_length_rejected : ¬HostLocality.responseWellFormed HostLocality.alteredLengthFixture

theorems.name: HostLocality.altered_result_tag_breaks_wrapper_refinement
theorems.claim: Two responses cannot both exactly refine one decision when their result tags differ.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.altered_result_tag_breaks_wrapper_refinement : ∀ (decision : HostLocality.ReadDecision) (expected altered : HostLocality.WireResponse), HostLocality.WrapperResponseRefines decision expected → HostLocality.WrapperResponseRefines decision altered → altered.tag ≠ expected.tag → False

theorems.name: HostLocality.altered_result_length_breaks_wrapper_refinement
theorems.claim: Two responses cannot both exactly refine one decision when their lengths differ.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.altered_result_length_breaks_wrapper_refinement : ∀ (decision : HostLocality.ReadDecision) (expected altered : HostLocality.WireResponse), HostLocality.WrapperResponseRefines decision expected → HostLocality.WrapperResponseRefines decision altered → altered.length ≠ expected.length → False

theorems.name: HostLocality.malformed_tag_does_not_restore
theorems.claim: The unsupported-tag fixture aborts with the exact suspended stack and borrowed-owner state unchanged.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.malformed_tag_does_not_restore : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), have after := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned HostLocality.malformedTagFixture)); after.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ after.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ after.borrowed = some borrow

theorems.name: HostLocality.altered_length_does_not_restore
theorems.claim: The altered-length fixture aborts without restoring the borrowed owner or continuing the guest.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.altered_length_does_not_restore : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), have after := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned HostLocality.alteredLengthFixture)); after.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ after.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ after.borrowed = some borrow

theorems.name: HostLocality.host_locality_preserves_projection
theorems.claim: The independent host-locality premise preserves the unrelated owner, resource snapshot, and protected surrounding cells in the frame projection.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.host_locality_preserves_projection : ∀ (before after : HostLocality.FrameProjection), HostLocality.PreservesFrame before after → HostLocality.frameProjection before = HostLocality.frameProjection after

theorems.name: HostLocality.m5_table_complete_exact
theorems.claim: For the selected actual M5 table record in an authentic Busy scope, Table.decide completion agrees with normal_completion_owner_once and table_decide_refines, returning exactly one owner and the exact M5 accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.m5_table_complete_exact : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), (↑table.records)[↑record.handle.slot]? = some record → M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Busy serial → M5Resources.scopeCheck record serial = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → table.decide record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete serial outcome) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome }) ∧ { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 1#usize, owners_returned := 1#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.bounded_read_frame_and_restoration
theorems.claim: Given independent frame-locality, exact wrapper response, adapter-update, identity, bounds, and actual M5-table premises, a completed bounded read preserves the frame, restores only the declared owner in order, preserves response and read/release counters, and uses the actual M5 completion decision and accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.bounded_read_frame_and_restoration : ∀ (scenario : HostLocality.CompletedReadScenario), HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameBefore = HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.region = scenario.adapterBefore.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.region = scenario.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.owner = none ∧ (scenario.adapterAfter.record = have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.owner = some { handle := scenario.record.handle } ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters = HostLocality.countersAfterRead scenario.adapterBefore.counters (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.releases = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.releases ∧ HostLocality.readCounterRoom scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest scenario.borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned scenario.response)) = HostLocality.restoredGuest scenario.borrow scenario.response ∧ scenario.borrow.owner = scenario.record.handle ∧ scenario.response = HostLocality.encodeDecision (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed) ∧ HostLocality.FrameSeparated scenario.record.handle scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.table.decide scenario.record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete scenario.serial (HostLocality.completionOf (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed))) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned (HostLocality.completionOf (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed)) }) ∧ { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned (HostLocality.completionOf (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed)) }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 1#usize, owners_returned := 1#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.successful_read_frame_and_restoration
theorems.claim: An authorized bounded read returns the exact region slice, restores only the declared borrowed owner, preserves the frame and release count, increments protected/read counters once, and follows the actual M5 Success completion accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.successful_read_frame_and_restoration : ∀ (scenario : HostLocality.CompletedReadScenario), scenario.accessAllowed = true → HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameBefore = HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.region = scenario.adapterBefore.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.region = scenario.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.owner = none ∧ (scenario.adapterAfter.record = have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.owner = some { handle := scenario.record.handle } ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters = HostLocality.countersAfterRead scenario.adapterBefore.counters (HostLocality.ReadDecision.success (List.take scenario.request.length (List.drop scenario.request.offset scenario.region.bytes))) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.releases = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.releases ∧ HostLocality.readCounterRoom scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest scenario.borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned scenario.response)) = HostLocality.restoredGuest scenario.borrow scenario.response ∧ scenario.borrow.owner = scenario.record.handle ∧ scenario.response = HostLocality.encodeDecision (HostLocality.ReadDecision.success (List.take scenario.request.length (List.drop scenario.request.offset scenario.region.bytes))) ∧ HostLocality.FrameSeparated scenario.record.handle scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.table.decide scenario.record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete scenario.serial noble_kernel.resources.Completion.Success) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned noble_kernel.resources.Completion.Success }) ∧ { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned noble_kernel.resources.Completion.Success }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 1#usize, owners_returned := 1#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.domain_error_read_frame_and_restoration
theorems.claim: An in-bounds exact-handle read denied by native access returns the exact modeled domain error, restores only the declared borrowed owner, preserves frame and adapter counters, and follows the actual M5 DomainError completion accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.domain_error_read_frame_and_restoration : ∀ (scenario : HostLocality.CompletedReadScenario), scenario.accessAllowed = false → HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameBefore = HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.region = scenario.adapterBefore.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.region = scenario.region ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.owner = none ∧ (scenario.adapterAfter.record = have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.owner = some { handle := scenario.record.handle } ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters = scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.releases = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.releases ∧ HostLocality.readCounterRoom scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest scenario.borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned scenario.response)) = HostLocality.restoredGuest scenario.borrow scenario.response ∧ scenario.borrow.owner = scenario.record.handle ∧ scenario.response = HostLocality.encodeDecision (HostLocality.ReadDecision.domainError HostLocality.invalidHandleBytes) ∧ HostLocality.FrameSeparated scenario.record.handle scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.table.decide scenario.record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete scenario.serial noble_kernel.resources.Completion.DomainError) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned noble_kernel.resources.Completion.DomainError }) ∧ { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned noble_kernel.resources.Completion.DomainError }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 1#usize, owners_returned := 1#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.preflight_domain_error_frame_and_restoration
theorems.claim: A representation, handle, or bounds preflight refusal has a modeled domain-error response, leaves adapter state and the unrelated frame unchanged, and restores only the declared borrowed owner after response validation without claiming an M5 completion.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.preflight_domain_error_frame_and_restoration : ∀ (scenario : HostLocality.PreflightReadScenario), HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameBefore = HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.adapterAfter = scenario.adapterBefore ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters = scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest scenario.borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned scenario.response)) = HostLocality.restoredGuest scenario.borrow scenario.response ∧ scenario.borrow.owner = scenario.request.claim ∧ scenario.response = HostLocality.encodeDecision (HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed) ∧ (∃ message, HostLocality.readDecision scenario.region scenario.request scenario.accessAllowed = HostLocality.ReadDecision.domainError message) ∧ HostLocality.FrameSeparated scenario.adapterBefore.record.handle scenario.frameAfter

theorems.name: HostLocality.m5_table_release_exact
theorems.claim: For a valid selected Live M5 record, Table.decide and the generated release refinement retire the record as LocalRelease with no owner return and exactly one local-release accounting unit.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.m5_table_release_exact : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), (↑table.records)[↑record.handle.slot]? = some record → M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → M5Resources.liveCheck record (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → table.decide record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Release (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle)) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ noble_kernel.resources.transition.release record (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 1#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.consuming_release_does_not_restore_guest_owner
theorems.claim: The consuming-release model removes the owner from the guest stack, clears borrowed state, continues without returning it, and differs from appending the consumed owner.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.consuming_release_does_not_restore_guest_owner : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).stack = borrow.prefix ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).borrowed = none ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.continuing ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).stack ≠ borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner borrow.owner]

theorems.name: HostLocality.consuming_release_boundary_does_not_restore_and_accounts_once
theorems.claim: Under the explicit successful Host::release refinement, consuming release preserves the unrelated frame, does not restore the guest owner, clears the host owner, increments the release counter once without overflow, and agrees with actual M5 release decisions and accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.consuming_release_boundary_does_not_restore_and_accounts_once : ∀ (scenario : HostLocality.ConsumingReleaseScenario), HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameBefore = HostLocality.frameProjection scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.region = scenario.adapterBefore.region ∧ (scenario.adapterAfter.record = have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }) ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.owner = none ∧ scenario.adapterBefore.owner = some { handle := scenario.record.handle } ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.protectedOperations = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.protectedOperations ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.regionReads = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.regionReads ∧ scenario.adapterAfter.counters.releases = scenario.adapterBefore.counters.releases + 1 ∧ HostLocality.releaseCounterRoom scenario.adapterBefore.counters ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner scenario.borrow).stack = scenario.borrow.prefix ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner scenario.borrow).borrowed = none ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner scenario.borrow).phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.continuing ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner scenario.borrow).stack ≠ scenario.borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner scenario.borrow.owner] ∧ scenario.borrow.owner = scenario.record.handle ∧ HostLocality.FrameSeparated scenario.record.handle scenario.frameAfter ∧ scenario.table.decide scenario.record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Release (HostLocality.requirementFor scenario.record.handle)) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ noble_kernel.resources.transition.release scenario.record (HostLocality.requirementFor scenario.record.handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ { record := have __src := scenario.record; { handle := __src.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := __src.last_scope, retirement := __src.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 1#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.consuming_release_does_not_restore
theorems.claim: The actual M5 table and generated release refinement plus the guest consuming model return no owner and account only a local release.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.consuming_release_does_not_restore : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), (↑table.records)[↑record.handle.slot]? = some record → M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → M5Resources.liveCheck record (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState), borrow.owner = record.handle → (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).stack = borrow.prefix ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).borrowed = none ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.continuing ∧ (HostLocality.consumeGuestOwner borrow).stack ≠ borrow.prefix ++ [HostLocality.StackCell.owner borrow.owner] ∧ borrow.owner = record.handle ∧ table.decide record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Release (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle)) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ noble_kernel.resources.transition.release record (HostLocality.requirementFor record.handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 1#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_success_is_selected_invoked_and_consuming
theorems.claim: When an owner remains, successful cleanup selects and invokes one release and leaves no owner retained by the adapter model.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_success_is_selected_invoked_and_consuming : ∀ (owner : noble_kernel.resources.Owner), HostLocality.runCleanup (some owner) true = { selection := HostLocality.CleanupSelection.release owner, invocation := HostLocality.CleanupInvocation.invokeRelease owner, outcome := HostLocality.CleanupOutcome.succeeded, ownerAfter := none }

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_failure_is_selected_invoked_and_retained
theorems.claim: When cleanup release fails, the selection and invocation are recorded and the rejected owner remains retained; cleanup success is not assumed.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_failure_is_selected_invoked_and_retained : ∀ (owner : noble_kernel.resources.Owner), HostLocality.runCleanup (some owner) false = { selection := HostLocality.CleanupSelection.release owner, invocation := HostLocality.CleanupInvocation.invokeRelease owner, outcome := HostLocality.CleanupOutcome.failed, ownerAfter := some owner }

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_success_counts_one_release
theorems.claim: A successful modeled cleanup contributes exactly one release to its accounting delta.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_success_counts_one_release : ∀ (owner : noble_kernel.resources.Owner), HostLocality.cleanupReleaseDelta (HostLocality.runCleanup (some owner) true) = 1

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_failure_counts_no_release
theorems.claim: A failed modeled cleanup contributes no successful release to its accounting delta.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_failure_counts_no_release : ∀ (owner : noble_kernel.resources.Owner), HostLocality.cleanupReleaseDelta (HostLocality.runCleanup (some owner) false) = 0

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_without_owner_is_skipped
theorems.claim: Cleanup with no retained owner is skipped and does not invoke release.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_without_owner_is_skipped : HostLocality.runCleanup none true = { selection := HostLocality.CleanupSelection.skip, invocation := HostLocality.CleanupInvocation.notInvoked, outcome := HostLocality.CleanupOutcome.skipped, ownerAfter := none }

theorems.name: HostLocality.abnormal_cleanup_does_not_restore_guest
theorems.claim: Cleanup success or failure after a malformed response cannot revive guest continuation or restore the borrowed owner.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.abnormal_cleanup_does_not_restore_guest : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState) (response : HostLocality.WireResponse), ¬HostLocality.responseWellFormed response → ∀ (owner : Option noble_kernel.resources.Owner) (cleanupSucceeded : Bool), have guest := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) (HostLocality.HostExit.returned response)); have result := HostLocality.applyCleanup guest owner cleanupSucceeded; result.1.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ result.1.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ result.1.borrowed = some borrow

theorems.name: HostLocality.trapped_cleanup_does_not_restore_guest
theorems.claim: Cleanup success or failure after a trap cannot revive guest continuation or restore the borrowed owner.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.trapped_cleanup_does_not_restore_guest : ∀ (borrow : HostLocality.BorrowState) (owner : Option noble_kernel.resources.Owner) (cleanupSucceeded : Bool), have guest := HostLocality.restoreBorrow (HostLocality.validateExit (HostLocality.collectGuest borrow) HostLocality.HostExit.trapped); have result := HostLocality.applyCleanup guest owner cleanupSucceeded; result.1.phase = HostLocality.GuestPhase.aborted ∧ result.1.stack = borrow.prefix ∧ result.1.borrowed = some borrow

theorems.name: HostLocality.cleanup_success_is_not_selected_twice
theorems.claim: After successful cleanup clears the owner, a second cleanup is skipped, not invoked, and contributes no second release.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.cleanup_success_is_not_selected_twice : ∀ (owner : noble_kernel.resources.Owner), have traces := HostLocality.cleanupTwice (some owner) true true; traces.1.selection = HostLocality.CleanupSelection.release owner ∧ traces.1.invocation = HostLocality.CleanupInvocation.invokeRelease owner ∧ traces.1.outcome = HostLocality.CleanupOutcome.succeeded ∧ traces.2.selection = HostLocality.CleanupSelection.skip ∧ traces.2.invocation = HostLocality.CleanupInvocation.notInvoked ∧ traces.2.outcome = HostLocality.CleanupOutcome.skipped ∧ HostLocality.cleanupReleaseDelta traces.1 = 1 ∧ HostLocality.cleanupReleaseDelta traces.2 = 0

theorems.name: HostLocality.m5_double_retirement_has_no_second_release
theorems.claim: The first M5 retirement performs LocalRelease and a second retirement of the already-retired record is unchanged with zero further accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.m5_double_retirement_has_no_second_release : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (firstReason secondReason : noble_kernel.resources.Retirement), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Retire firstReason) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := some firstReason }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }) ∧ noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := some firstReason } record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Retire secondReason) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (M5Resources.unchanged { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := some firstReason })) ∧ (M5Resources.unchanged { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := some firstReason }).accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.abnormal_late_completion_is_idempotent
theorems.claim: A completion arriving after an M5 record is Retired remains unchanged and contributes zero accounting.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.abnormal_late_completion_is_idempotent : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → M5Resources.scopeCheck record serial = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete serial outcome) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (M5Resources.unchanged record)) ∧ (M5Resources.unchanged record).accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_table_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A mismatch in the actual M5 Handle table component is rejected as InvalidHandle.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_table_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table ≠ claim.table → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.InvalidHandle

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_slot_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A mismatch in the actual M5 Handle slot component is rejected as InvalidHandle.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_slot_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table = claim.table → retained.slot ≠ claim.slot → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.InvalidHandle

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_context_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A context-only M5 Handle mismatch with table and slot held equal is rejected as WrongContext.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_context_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table = claim.table → retained.slot = claim.slot → retained.context ≠ claim.context → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.WrongContext

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_generation_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A generation-only M5 Handle mismatch with earlier checked components equal is rejected as WrongGeneration.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_generation_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table = claim.table → retained.slot = claim.slot → retained.context = claim.context → retained.kind = claim.kind → retained.generation ≠ claim.generation → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.WrongGeneration

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_kind_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A kind-only M5 Handle mismatch with table, slot, and context equal is rejected as WrongKind.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_kind_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table = claim.table → retained.slot = claim.slot → retained.context = claim.context → retained.kind ≠ claim.kind → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.WrongKind

theorems.name: HostLocality.wrong_rights_identity_rejected
theorems.claim: A rights-only M5 Handle mismatch with earlier checked components equal is rejected as WrongRights.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.wrong_rights_identity_rejected : ∀ (retained claim : HostLocality.Handle), retained.table = claim.table → retained.slot = claim.slot → retained.context = claim.context → retained.generation = claim.generation → retained.kind = claim.kind → retained.rights ≠ claim.rights → M5Resources.handleCheck retained claim = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.WrongRights

theorems.name: HostLocality.unrelated_frame_mutation_rejected
theorems.claim: A mutation of protected surrounding cells while unrelated owner and state remain equal violates the locality premise.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.unrelated_frame_mutation_rejected : ∀ (before after : HostLocality.FrameProjection), before.unrelatedOwner.handle = after.unrelatedOwner.handle → before.unrelatedState = after.unrelatedState → before.protectedCells ≠ after.protectedCells → ¬HostLocality.PreservesFrame before after

theorems.name: HostLocality.unrelated_owner_mutation_rejected
theorems.claim: Changing the unrelated owner's exact M5 Handle violates the locality premise.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.unrelated_owner_mutation_rejected : ∀ (before after : HostLocality.FrameProjection), before.unrelatedOwner.handle ≠ after.unrelatedOwner.handle → ¬HostLocality.PreservesFrame before after

theorems.name: HostLocality.unrelated_state_mutation_rejected
theorems.claim: Changing the unrelated resource snapshot violates the locality premise.
theorems.statement: HostLocality.unrelated_state_mutation_rejected : ∀ (before after : HostLocality.FrameProjection), before.unrelatedState ≠ after.unrelatedState → ¬HostLocality.PreservesFrame before after

theorems.name: M5Resources.transition_refines
theorems.statement: M5Resources.transition_refines : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (claim : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (event : noble_kernel.resources.Event), noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record claim event = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (M5Resources.step record claim event)

theorems.name: M5Resources.table_decide_refines
theorems.statement: M5Resources.table_decide_refines : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (claim : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (event : noble_kernel.resources.Event), table.decide claim event = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (M5Resources.tableStep table claim event)

theorems.name: M5Resources.normal_completion_owner_once
theorems.statement: M5Resources.normal_completion_owner_once : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Busy serial → M5Resources.scopeCheck record serial = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete serial outcome) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome }) ∧ { record := { handle := record.handle, state := noble_kernel.resources.State.Live, last_scope := record.last_scope, retirement := record.retirement }, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome }.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 1#usize, owners_returned := 1#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }

theorems.name: M5Resources.release_refines
theorems.statement: M5Resources.release_refines : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (required : noble_kernel.resources.Requirement), noble_kernel.resources.transition.release record required = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (M5Resources.release record required)

theorems.name: M5Resources.retired_completion_idempotent
theorems.statement: M5Resources.retired_completion_idempotent : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → M5Resources.scopeCheck record serial = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok () → noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete serial outcome) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (M5Resources.unchanged record)) ∧ (M5Resources.unchanged record).accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok { pins_acquired := 0#usize, pins_released := 0#usize, owners_returned := 0#usize, owners_transferred := 0#usize, local_releases := 0#usize }
